product_one_liner: An EV charger in every parking space
product_description_excerpt: Starlight Charging makes a new type of EV charging system specifically for multifamily buildings, offices, and hotels. It uses power-sharing mesh technology so property managers can install chargers for 1/10th the cost and see a positive ROI after just 8 months.
